_comment: Example scoring model classification manifest for Performax deployment operators.
_instructions: Specify cycle UUIDs as keys, with either a model string ('LEGACY_CRITERIA' or 'COMPETENCY_FRAMEWORK') or an object with scoring_model and reason. Hybrid cycles (cycles with both legacy ratings and transitional technical parameters) require 'acknowledged_hybrid': true when classified as LEGACY_CRITERIA.

<standard-ambiguous-cycle-uuid>.reason: Verified modern draft cycle with no legacy ratings

<transitional-hybrid-cycle-uuid>.reason: Transitional cycle with technical parameters reviewed and intentionally classified as legacy criteria
